title: 📖 Noun Declensions (Neuter)
description: Learn how neuter nouns decline in Sanskrit.

sections.title: 📖 Neuter Noun Patterns
sections.content: Most neuter nouns end in 'म्' (m). Here's how they decline:
sections.note: Notice: In neuter nouns, the nominative and accusative are always the same!

questions.question: What is the nominative form of 'फल' (fruit)?
How do you say 'with a fruit'?
questions.explanation: 'फलेन' is the instrumental case (with a fruit).
